title: Governed SMS Messaging & Channel Activation
checkpointRule: Capability prerequisites may be qualified before their whole checkpoint completes. Full phase completion requires all checkpoints and selected profiles; no backward gate on predecessor phases.

acceptanceCases.requiredProof: With only the Phase 17 generation or an unqualified profile, every SMS creation path remains unavailable; existing evidence still reads correctly.
Activating one exact source purpose does not activate another purpose, tenant, sender, country or channel; missing required proof rejects before work exists.
A real verified setup reaches usable readiness; partial/rejected/stale registration and forged account ownership never do.
Secret rotation and route replacement preserve current scope; copied ciphertext, another tenant's account and revoked credentials fail safely.
Explicit enrollment captures the required disclosure and phone-purpose evidence; a gift, email opt-in, imported number or staff checkbox alone cannot enroll.
Shared, corrected, reassigned and changed phones do not inherit private threads or old consent; ambiguous identity remains a visible unresolved state.
A do-not-contact change or source eligibility loss between preview and admission prevents the affected send, including a required/urgent-labelled request.
STOP and reasonable withdrawal suppress before ordinary follow-up, including unresolved Party matching, repeated events and adverse orderings.
HELP changes no permission; START/provider-unblock without complete fresh applicable evidence cannot resume recurring outreach.
Provider-generated control response is recorded without a duplicate platform response; ordinary acknowledgments cannot loop with another autoresponder.
Real signature validation covers trusted proxy URL construction, all required parameters, JSON variants, tampering, replay and wrong-account routing.
Fully personalized text crosses GSM/Unicode/concatenation boundaries correctly; no truncation, protected-link change or hidden encoding rewrite occurs.
Quiet hours, unknown zone, daylight-saving boundaries, source expiration and delayed recovery produce the documented not-before/expired outcomes.
Budget and provider throttling truthfully defer/refuse new optional work without dropping accepted intent or blocking withdrawal ingestion.
Double submit, response loss, concurrent native/Studio requests and replay beyond provider caches preserve one semantic effect identity.
Cancel/withdrawal versus admission has a deterministic boundary; already-submitted work remains truthfully irreversible or uncertain.
Provider acceptance with a lost response, including no stored provider ID, cannot cause a fresh-key retry or automatic route/provider failover.
Late, duplicate and reordered delivery observations do not invent reading or business completion; incompatible evidence requires reconciliation.
One actual source-backed system notice succeeds with optional Workflow Studio absent; existing required email/in-product behavior stays intact.
Fault and overload drills retain all durably accepted restrictions and outcomes, enforce fair capacity and expose independently detected outages.
An inbound message, assignment, collision-safe staff reply and later response work through the actual Support Hub and one communication history.
A sender port, reassignment, disconnect or ownership change cannot attach a new correspondent to prior private conversation history.
Internal notes, raw attachments, sealed-care context and unrelated recipient details cannot escape through SMS, exports, previews or diagnostics.
Known and unknown keyword requesters receive only a permitted source-coded public giving link; no Party claim, consent enrollment or payment occurs.
A retired designation, changed route, malicious keyword/URL, repeated request and link scanner cannot misdirect a gift or perform a hidden action.
A reviewed campaign sends only currently eligible intended recipients, shows exact exclusions and does not execute twice through native/provider lanes.
Schedule/change/stop and partial campaign failure retain original occurrence identity and truthful per-recipient outcomes without blocking email-only work.
Import or provider migration retains provenance and restrictions; incomplete legacy evidence remains unconsented rather than silently repaired.
Privacy/retention and backup restore preserve minimal required restriction/effect evidence without resurrecting removed content or repeating messages.
Killing new SMS sends preserves withdrawal, authenticated late-outcome intake, authorized history and recovery; reconnect does not replay old campaigns.
Real administrator, campaign author and support agent complete their jobs with keyboard, screen reader and narrow-screen layouts.
The approved provider/market profile completes all three checkpoints with measured performance/cost, operating runbooks and a representative tenant pilot.

dispatchRule: Reconcile existing issues and exact owner contracts, close the affected qualification decisions, then publish bounded implementation tickets. Null githubIssue means no issue has been created.
